question: What claim is made about the classes of yoginīs with respect to their origin and function?
premises: All are born of the family.
All are guardians of the doors.
inference: The yoginīs are of all classes: innate, family-born, and guardians of all doors.
uncertainties: The relation between these three classes is not specified here.
plain_english: All are innate, all are family-born, all are guardians of the doors.
